observations.summary: UKMTO reported a tanker hit on the stern approximately 11 nautical miles north of Khasab and a second engine-room projectile report 17 nautical miles east. Whether these describe one vessel or two remains unresolved. No casualties reported; Iran's separate mine claim is unverified and not an independent confirmation.
observations.title: UKMTO reports tanker projectile incidents near Oman's Khasab

observations.publisher: Reuters reporting Finnish Defence Forces and Border Guard
observations.summary: Finnish defence and border authorities reported the Russian Sparta II was damaged by drones in international waters, subsequently drifted into Finnish waters, and prompted rescue operations and temporary air/maritime restrictions. Finnish officials said Ukraine was likely responsible but attribution remains unconfirmed; a suspected Russian helicopter airspace violation may relate to rescue or monitoring.
observations.title: Damaged Russian Sparta II cargo ship enters Finnish waters; Finland restricts air and maritime traffic
